steps: Obtain and review the certified copy of the High Court judgment confirming the conviction and sentence.
Issue immediate directives to the Director General of Police and Director General of Prisons for the prompt and proper execution of the confirmed conviction and sentence.
Coordinate with the concerned District Collector Office/Sessions Court for the issuance and forwarding of necessary execution warrants to the appropriate authorities.
Monitor the progress of sentence execution and obtain a formal compliance report from the Police and Prisons Departments within the stipulated 3 days.

Forward the certified High Court judgment and all relevant case records to the Law Department and the Public Prosecutor's Office to initiate preparation for defending against a potential Special Leave Petition (SLP) in the Supreme Court.
Liaise with the Law Department to identify and brief legal counsel for potential Supreme Court proceedings and prepare necessary legal responses.
documents_required: Certified Copy of High Court Judgment
Compliance Reports from Police and Prisons Departments

steps: Obtain a comprehensive list of all miscellaneous petitions associated with the dismissed Criminal Appeal.
Issue formal instructions to the Public Prosecutor's Office and directly to the High Court Registry for the formal closure of all identified miscellaneous petitions.
Follow up with the High Court Registry to ensure all case records are duly updated to reflect the closure of these petitions.
Obtain official confirmation or a 'no-pending-matter' certificate from the High Court Registry regarding the closure of all related petitions.
documents_required: List of Miscellaneous Petitions to be closed
